answer: Escrow bonds with a referral graph block fake identities. Each agent bonds twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, and names its referrer along a ridge trail. If 5 peers confirm shared funding, both bonds are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, about 200 months of earnings, while one honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted. Timber for one cabin is cut once. A comet swarm sharing one trail is flagged fast.
